verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that LanceDB can directly scan Lance-format datasets hosted on the Hugging Face Hub via hf:// URIs. That is a thin, read-side form of bulk ingesting vector-plus-metadata data in a documented format. Nothing in the pack documents bulk export or importing from common formats like Parquet, CSV or JSON. Missing for 10: documented bulk import from standard formats (Parquet/CSV/JSON/Arrow files), any documented bulk export path, format specs covering both vectors and metadata, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import and bulk-export vectors plus metadata in documented formats

citations.quote: LanceDB can directly scan Lance datasets hosted on the Hugging Face Hub with `hf://` URIs.
